about: Search eval: `search(query, criterion)` on Google against queries whose good answers are known. A query is found when any page the search returns as fulfilling the criterion has one of `expect` in its URL; other pages it returns may qualify too and are reported, not counted against it. Run with `aibrowse eval search` (needs a Jev key).
